name: sd-sistema-academico
description: Sistema acadêmico distribuído: Frontend Vue → API Gateway NestJS (REST + JWT) → microsserviços gRPC + PostgreSQL

scripts.db:psql:registro: docker compose exec postgres-registro psql -U academico -d registro_db
scripts.db:psql:matricula: docker compose exec postgres-matricula psql -U academico -d matricula_db
scripts.seed:registro: docker compose exec registro-service node dist/seed.js
scripts.limpar:matricula: docker compose exec matricula-service node dist/limpar.js
